description: This file defines a minimal API endpoint for listing catalog types in an e-commerce web application. It uses ASP.NET Core minimal APIs and dependency injection to handle requests and return a list of catalog types mapped to DTOs.

classes.name: CatalogTypeListEndpoint
classes.description: A minimal API endpoint class for retrieving a list of catalog types, implementing dependency injection for IMapper, and defining route setup and handler logic.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Sets up the GET route for 'api/catalog-types' and associates the request handler.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the logic to retrieve catalog types from the repository, map them to DTOs, and return the result.
